day_titles.4: To Paro: Paro and Kyichu Lhakhang

1: Arrival at Paro International and transfer to Thimphu
The road east along the Pa Chhu and the Wang Chhu
Check in and the rest of the day free
2: Breakfast, then out into the capital
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma
3: Breakfast, then east over the Dochula pass
The hundred and eight chortens at the top
Punakha Dzong between the Pho and Mo rivers
The long suspension bridge over the water
4: Breakfast, then west down the valley to Paro
Terraced fields and farmhouses the whole way
A guided round of the Paro valley
Kyichu Lhakhang, among the oldest temples in Bhutan
5: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The climb up the pine slope to Taktsang
The monastery wedged into the cliff face
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Paro International for your flight home

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Five nights, flying both ways into Paro. The shortest trip that still gets you over the Dochula pass to Punakha.
expert.tip: Book the Paro flights early for March and October. Drukair and Bhutan Airlines are the only carriers and the seats go fast.

summary: 6 days through Thimphu, Punakha, Paro, with 5 nights, daily breakfast and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu sightseeing with simtokha dzong, the punakha sightseeing tour, the paro sightseeing with kyichu lhakhang, the hike to the tiger's nest.
included: Included: 5 nights across Thimphu, Punakha, Paro with daily breakfast; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu sightseeing with Simtokha Dzong; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the Paro sightseeing with Kyichu Lhakhang; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
